daily.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
daily.summary: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
Kth Largest Element in an Array

two sum.approach: Walk the array once and keep a dictionary from each value to its index. For each number, check whether target minus that number is already in the dictionary.

longest substring.approach: Use a sliding window with a dictionary of the last index of each character. When a repeat appears inside the window, move the left edge just past its previous position.
longest substring.complexity: O(n) time, O(k) space where k is the alphabet size.

valid parentheses.approach: Push opening brackets on a stack. For each closing bracket, the top of the stack must be its matching opener, and the stack must be empty at the end.
